title: Add-on build configuration
description: Build-time settings for one add-on. Pack identity (UUIDs, versions, min_engine_version) lives in each pack's manifest.json, not here.

name.description: Human-readable add-on name, used in build output and package filenames.

description.description: One-line summary of what the add-on does.

scriptEntry.description: TypeScript entry point, relative to the add-on folder. If the file is absent, the add-on is treated as script-free.

scriptOut.description: Where the bundle is written inside the built behavior pack. Must match the script module's "entry" in behavior_pack/manifest.json.
